priorityPolicy.highYield: Definitions, canonical derivations, SQL edge cases, and repeated lecture/project moves that deserve first-pass revision.
priorityPolicy.support: Source-backed examples or setup pages that help follow a high-yield concept but should not crowd the first revision pass.
priorityPolicy.context: Titles, history, logistics, and other source pages retained for provenance without extra Atlas teaching prose.
priorityPolicy.caveat: This is a study filter, not a prediction from historical papers; no supplied DSA5104 past-year paper is available.

disclaimer: No real DSA5104 past-year paper was found in the supplied local DSA5104 source folder on 2026-08-26. Synthetic questions are labeled synthetic-final and must not be treated as historical exam evidence. Future Ch4, Ch5, Ch7, Ch9, XML, MongoDB, MapReduce, Spark SQL, and VectorDB scope remains source-pending until the relevant course material is supplied.
